arxiv-2012-01391.title: The 𝔽 p {\mathbb{F}}_{p} -Selberg integral of type A n A_{n}
arxiv-2012-01391.creator: Richárd Rimányi ⋄ and Alexander Varchenko ⋆
arxiv-2012-01391.description: Abstract . We prove an 𝔽 p {\mathbb{F}}_{p} -Selberg integral formula of type A n A_{n} , in which the 𝔽 p {\mathbb{F}}_{p} -Selberg integral is an element of the finite field 𝔽 p {\mathbb{F}}_{p} with odd prime number p p of elements.

arxiv-2307-07666.title: Efficient Action Robust Reinforcement Learning with Probabilistic Policy Execution Uncertainty
arxiv-2307-07666.creator: Guanlin Liu, Davis, Davis, CA 95616, Zhihan Zhou, Evanston, IL 60208, Han Liu, Evanston, IL 60208, Lifeng Lai, Davis, Davis, CA 95616
arxiv-2307-07666.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Guanlin Liu, Davis, Davis, CA 95616, Zhihan Zhou, Evanston, IL 60208, Han Liu, Evanston, IL 60208, Lifeng Lai, Davis, Davis, CA 95616. Robust reinforcement learning (RL) aims to find a policy that optimizes the worst-case performance in the face of uncertainties.

arxiv-2406-10004.title: Cohomological stabilization, perverse filtrations, and refined BPS invariants for del Pezzo surfaces
arxiv-2406-10004.creator: Weite Pi, Junliang Shen, Fei Si, Feinuo Zhang
arxiv-2406-10004.description: Abstract . We prove an asymptotic product formula for the refined BPS invariants associated with a local del Pezzo surface. Our formula governs the cohomological stabilization of the perverse filtration on the intersection cohomology of the moduli space of 1-dimensional semistable sheaves on a del Pezzo surface.

arxiv-2507-15890.title: Quantum Complementarity ad Infinitum: Switching Higher-Order Coherence from Infinity to Zero
arxiv-2507-15890.creator: Arash Azizi
arxiv-2507-15890.description: Abstract We report a profound manifestation of quantum complementarity in the higher-order photon statistics of the “Janus state,” a coherent superposition of two squeezed vacua. We find that the state acts as a perfect quantum switch for multi-photon correlations, toggled by the availability of which-path information. Erasing this information activates quantum interference that can be tuned to be maximally destructive.

arxiv-2509-19621.title: Gamma Acyclicity, Annotated Relations, and Consistency Witness Functions
arxiv-2509-19621.creator: Albert Atserias, Phokion G. Kolaitis
arxiv-2509-19621.description: Abstract During the early days of relational database theory it was realized that “acyclic” database schemas possess a number of desirable semantic properties. In fact, three different notions of “acyclicity” were identified and extensively investigated during the 1980s, namely, α \alpha -acyclicity, β \beta -acyclicity, and γ \gamma -acyclicity.

arxiv-2602-13421.title: Metabolic cost of information processing in Poisson variational autoencoders
arxiv-2602-13421.creator: Hadi Vafaii, Jacob L. Yates Redwood Center for Theoretical Neuroscience, UC Berkeley
arxiv-2602-13421.description: Abstract Computation in biological systems is fundamentally energy-constrained, yet standard theories of computation treat energy as freely available. Here, we argue that variational free energy minimization under a Poisson assumption offers a principled path toward an energy-aware theory of computation.

pmc-10575862.title: Spatial and temporal dynamics of West Nile virus between Africa and Europe
pmc-10575862.creator: Giulia Mencattelli, Marie Henriette Dior Ndione, Andrea Silverj, Moussa Moise Diagne, Valentina Curini, Liana Teodori, Marco Di Domenico, Rassoul Mbaye, Alessandra Leone, Maurilia Marcacci, Alioune Gaye, ElHadji Ndiaye, Diawo Diallo, Massimo Ancora, Barbara Secondini, Valeria Di Lollo, Iolanda Mango
pmc-10575862.description: It is unclear whether West Nile virus (WNV) circulates between Africa and Europe, despite numerous studies supporting an African origin and high transmission in Europe. We integrated genomic data with geographic observations and phylogenetic and phylogeographic inferences to uncover the spatial and temporal viral dynamics of WNV between these two continents.

pmc-10670419.title: Copper Ion Removal Using a Waste-Plastic-Derived Hydrogel Adsorbent Prepared via Microwave-Assisted PET Aminolysis
pmc-10670419.creator: Kayee Chan, Masami Kawai, Mina Yamake, Anatoly Zinchenko
pmc-10670419.description: Despite the tremendous progress in the development of functional materials from plastic waste to promote its recycling, only a few examples of hydrogel materials from plastic waste were reported. In this study, microwave-assisted depolymerization of waste PET plastic using polyamine was performed to prepare short aminophthalamide oligomers followed by chemically cross-linking into a hydrogel material.

pmc-11510992.title: Predicting the Invasion Risk of the Highly Invasive Acacia mearnsii in Asia under Global Climate Change
pmc-11510992.creator: Anil Poudel, Pradeep Adhikari, Prabhat Adhikari, Sue Hyuen Choi, Ji Yeon Yun, Yong Ho Lee, Sun Hee Hong
pmc-11510992.description: Acacia mearnsii, among the 100 worst invasive weeds worldwide, negatively impacts native biodiversity, agriculture, and natural ecosystems. Global climate change, characterized by rising temperatures and altered precipitation patterns, enhances the risk of A. mearnsii invasion in Asia, making it crucial to identify high-risk areas for effective management.

pmc-11674533.title: SPP1 mRNA Expression Is Associated with M2 Macrophage Infiltration and Poor Prognosis in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer
pmc-11674533.creator: Yu-Chia Chen, Chia-Ching Chen, Rong-Fu Chen, Hsin-Hung Chen, Po-Ming Chen, Madhav Bhatia
pmc-11674533.description: (1): Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is an especially aggressive form of breast cancer defined by a poor prognosis and a lack of effective treatment options. There is a pressing need for validated predictive and prognostic biomarkers to assist in making treatment decisions and improve the prognostic accuracy for patients with this challenging disease.

pmc-12683077.title: Point-of-Care Ultrasound in the Diagnosis of Pulmonary Embolism With Right Heart Strain: A Case Report of Dialysis Line-Related Complications
pmc-12683077.creator: Oussama Medjahed, Avinash K Jha, Ahmed Ahmed, Ayman Shaat
pmc-12683077.description: Pulmonary embolism (PE) represents a significant cause of preventable death among critically ill patients, with the immediate diagnosis impaired by the presence of hemodynamic compromise and limited access to advanced imaging. Point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS) is a rapid bedside tool for diagnosing right heart strain, which can aid in immediate clinical management.

pmc-12718478.title: Tracking Day Shift Nurses’ Work Patterns Using an Indoor Positioning System in an Internal Medicine Ward at a Japanese University Hospital
pmc-12718478.creator: Chifumi Otaki, Shintaro Izumi, Kana Fujimoto, Kyoko Inoue, Miki Nishikawa, Ayumi Teraoka, Izumi Saito
pmc-12718478.description: Background: The increasing complexity of medical care and the shortened hospital stays mandated by Japan’s Diagnosis Procedure Combination/Per-Diem Payment System (DPC/PDPS) necessitate the objective and efficient analysis of nursing workload. Given that traditional time-motion studies are resource-intensive, the use of an Indoor Positioning System (IPS) offers an unobtrusive and scalable solution for the continuous quantification of nurse activities.

pmc-13109866.title: Reconceptualizing school refusal behavior and related symptoms from an ecological perspective
pmc-13109866.creator: Xiaoxuan Fan, Kui Wang, Tengteng Fan, Wanling Zhang, Aihua Wang, Chao Yan, Yanyu Wang, Ying Li
pmc-13109866.description: cations for their psychological and academic development. This phenomenon emerged before the pandemic and was exacerbated afterward. According to Australian data, the proportion of students achieving 90% attendance dropped from 77.8% to 59.8% between 2015 and 2024. 2 Concurrently, a 2022 UK study reported that the persistent absence rate was 22.3% 3 ; double the pre‐pandemic level.

pmc-13143051.title: CRISP: Cremated remains inference of sex probabilities – A software for Bayesian sex estimation in human cremated remains
pmc-13143051.creator: Lukas Waltenberger, Sophie Beitel, Mattia Bischeri, Katharina Rebay-Salisbury, Alessandra Sperduti, Claudio Cavazzuti
pmc-13143051.description: Sex assessment in cremation contexts represents a key step for reconstructing funerary rituals and demographic profiles. However, the high degree of fragmentation and thermal alteration of skeletal elements significantly hampers this operation. Most often, the morphological traits of pelvis and skull are not preserved while the application of metric criteria follows those developed from modern reference series.

pmc-13273017.title: Engineered Nestin+ TSPC‐Derived Exosomes Promote Tendon Repair Via Metabolic Reprogramming
pmc-13273017.creator: Linxiang Cheng, Junyu Guo, Junshu Zhang, Qiangqiang Zheng, Zhixiong Zhang, Jingyao Chen, Jinhan Zhang, Xiao Chen, Zi Yin
pmc-13273017.description: Tendon repair remains a substantial clinical problem with limited treatment options. While Nestin+ tendon stem/progenitor cells (TSPCs) are known to regulate tendon healing, their clinical translation faces challenges. Here, we show that exosomes derived from engineered Nestin‐overexpressing TSPCs (Nes‐EVs) significantly ameliorate tendinopathy in multiple mouse models.

pmc-13479383.title: IMD-0354 optimization generates potent colistin adjuvants with in vivo activity and reduced eukaryotic toxicity
pmc-13479383.creator: Luke J Cowart, Ansley M Nemeth, Leigh A Jania, Moira Overly, Courtney F Ellis, Beverly H Koller, Roberta J Melander, Yohei Doi, Robert K Ernst, Christian Melander
pmc-13479383.description: The development of novel therapeutic approaches to combat infections that stem from extensively drug-resistant (XDR) gram-negative bacteria remains an area of significant unmet need. One such approach is the use of antibiotic adjuvants. Currently, colistin (polymyxin E) is used as the antibiotic of last resort for the treatment of XDR gram-negative bacterial infections.

pmc-13597270.title: Podocyte Vps34 deficiency drives early-onset glomerulopathy and mesangial IgA-dominant immune-complex deposition: a novel mouse model linking vesicular trafficking to glomerular immune dysregulation
pmc-13597270.creator: Shu Qu, Ting Gan, Ting-hui Qu, Shang Zeng, Yang Li, Ji-cheng Lv, Hong Zhang, Hou-hua Li, Hui Wang, Xu-jie Zhou
pmc-13597270.description: BackgroundPodocytes are indispensable for maintaining glomerular filtration barrier integrity and immune homeostasis. Although vacuolar protein sorting 34 (Vps34), a class III phosphoinositide 3-kinase, orchestrates intracellular membrane trafficking, its roles in glomerular immune regulation remain incompletely defined. This study identifies a critical link between podocyte-specific Vps34 dysfunction and glomerular immune injury, characterized by pronounced mesangial IgA deposition.

uslaw-usc-t42-s5852.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s5852.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 73 (Development Of Energy Sources); Subchapter II (Nuclear Regulatory Commission; Nuclear Whistleblower Protection). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Appropriations for salaries and expenses; additional purposes Funds appropriated for “Nuclear Regulatory Commission—Salaries and Expenses” shall be available to the Commission for the following additional purposes: (1) Employment of aliens. (2) Services.
